page_title: SAS 1-2 GEN | Sassuolo v Genoa 22/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' It looks like Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) saw red with that tackle. Marco Guida won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+3' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.

90+2' The game is interrupted. Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. That's a free kick to Genoa.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruslan Malinovsky.
89' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Marco Guida stops the game and makes a call.

87' 1 - 2 Goal! Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Andrea Consigli had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
86' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
86' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

86' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It will be a corner kick for Sassuolo.
84' Andrea Pinamonti comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
81' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) receives a reproachful look from Jeremy Toljan. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the left post.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
74' Substitution. Milan Badelj leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Strootman (Genoa).
73' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is flagged for offside.
70' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Josep Martinez (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.
69' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Now Sassuolo have a corner.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' 1 - 1 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Andrea Consigli into the bottom right corner.
64' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
63' It’s a PENALTY to Genoa after the VAR review!
63' There's a break in play and referee Marco Guida must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Genoa using VAR. This could be interesting!
62' Surely that's handball by one of the Sassuolo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
61' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
60' It is time for a substitution. Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is on for Mattia Bani.
60' The substitution is prepared. Aaron Martin (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Johan Vasquez.
60' Alessio Dionisi has decided to make a change. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) replaces Kristian Thorstvedt.
60' That's the end of the game for Samu Castillejo, who is replaced by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo).
58' The game is interrupted now, Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
56' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
56' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Andrea Consigli is alert and denies him.
52' Milan Badelj (Genoa) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well over the crossbar!
50' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
49' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
47' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) picks up an injury.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Alessio Dionisi gives a chance to Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) and Gian Marco Ferrari is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' A pass into the box finds Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Josep Martinez denies him.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Milan Badelj (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Guida has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
41' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
39' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) picks up a yellow card.
35' None of the Genoa players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
35' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play. Genoa are awarded a corner kick.
33' Wasted effort! Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
30' Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
28' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Armand Lauriente. The score is 1:0.
27' A long pass finds Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
22' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.

18' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Guida with no other option than to blow for a foul.
16' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
14' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
11' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is penalised for a foul. Marco Guida had a clear view and blows his whistle.
9' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
5' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
2' A corner kick by Genoa is thwarted by the well prepared Andrea Consigli (Sassuolo).
1' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Genoa will kick-off.
Marco Guida will supervise the game today.
